content.short: Vana is a Layer 1 blockchain for personal data ownership and monetization in the AI economy.
content.description: Vana is a specialized Layer 1 network designed to return data sovereignty to individuals by enabling them to own, pool, and monetize their personal data for AI training. Through its Data Liquidity Pools (DLPs), Vana allows users to securely contribute their digital footprints to develop community-owned AI models. By shifting the control of data from centralized corporations to the people who generate it, Vana creates a more equitable ecosystem for AI development. The network ensures that the value created by data is shared fairly between users and model developers on a secure blockchain.
content.meta: Vana is a Layer 1 blockchain for personal data ownership and decentralized AI training. Discover Vana and other Blockchains on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
